conditions_by_beat_id.28: Mysaria gives specific intelligence that directly causes Rhaenyra or another Black leader to change a plan or take action.
conditions_by_beat_id.31: Mysaria persuades Rhaenyra to take a course of action Rhaenyra was resisting earlier in the same scene.
conditions_by_beat_id.32: A named character gives Rhaenyra concrete evidence that Mysaria concealed, manipulated, or misrepresented something important.
conditions_by_beat_id.38: Rhaena knowingly makes a choice that immediately creates a new danger or materially worsens an existing crisis.
conditions_by_beat_id.78: A plan proposed by Tyland directly gets him and/or Aegon out of an immediate danger.
conditions_by_beat_id.89: Ormund reveals or executes a deception, ambush, planted agent, or prearranged scheme against an opposing force or named character.
conditions_by_beat_id.130: A named Black-aligned character directly discovers that Ulf has agreed to work with Ormund.
conditions_by_beat_id.157: Rhaenyra changes or abandons a plan after Torrhen raises a financial objection.

exclusions: Information, advice, evidence, an objection, a plan, a choice, or a pre-existing scheme alone does not count unless the preserved discovery, persuasion, change, escape, danger, or execution outcome also occurs.
Temporal sequence alone does not prove causation; the episode must directly connect the named input or choice to the preserved response or consequence.
A proxy account, off-screen report, recap, mention, dream, vision, memory, prediction, promotional image, or hypothetical outcome does not count.
families.title_review_note: Each title honestly names an information, persuasion, evidence, danger, deception, discovery, escape-plan, or objection outcome; settlement requires the preserved causal link rather than mere sequence.
